name: Discord Voice Deck for Stream Deck
headline: Turn Stream Deck Into Your Discord Voice Console
description:
Your Discord voice room on Stream Deck.

Discord Voice Deck for Stream Deck turns Stream Deck into a dedicated Discord voice control surface. See who is in voice, see who is talking, mute or deafen instantly, follow your active voice channel automatically, and keep Discord out of the way while gaming, streaming, or working.

Included actions cover Voice Status, Toggle Mute, Toggle Deafen, Mute + Deafen, Current Voice Channel, pinned Voice Member, Dynamic Member Slot, Speaker Spotlight, Voice Activity, Voice Member Count, Discord Connection, and a Stream Deck + Voice Navigator. Live member keys prioritize the avatar, name, and speaking state instead of tiny unreadable badges.

Discord Voice Deck includes purpose-built dashboards for Stream Deck MK.2 and other 5 by 3 models, Stream Deck XL, Stream Deck +, and Stream Deck Neo. Dynamic member slots repopulate automatically when people join or leave or when you switch voice channels. The default roster stays physically stable so keys do not jump around every time someone speaks, while Speaker Spotlight gives active speakers their own dedicated key.

Setup is intentionally small: install Discord Voice Deck, open Discord Desktop, add an action or use an included profile, and authorize Discord when prompted. The Discord Connection action clearly shows when Discord is closed, connecting, authorization is needed, or the plugin is ready.

Discord Voice Deck uses Discord Desktop's local RPC connection on Windows. It does not scrape user tokens, automate messages, act as a self bot, or expose Discord credentials to the Property Inspector. Session credentials are kept in process memory only.

Requires Windows, Discord Desktop, and Stream Deck 7.3 or newer. Discord Voice Deck for Stream Deck is an independent third-party product.

Part of the PackRat ecosystem.
release_notes: Initial release. Twelve Discord voice focused Stream Deck actions, live member roster and speaking state, mute and deafen controls, automatic voice channel following, stable dynamic member slots, Speaker Spotlight, Stream Deck + Voice Navigator, four included device-specific profiles, local-only Discord Desktop architecture, memory-only session credentials, official Stream Deck SDK v2 with SDKVersion 3.
